made a map of my world for a fantasy mapmaking event lore inside i went to a fantasy mapmaking workshop recently and made this map of the continent of kagzmerak a world im currently building its a part of a larger project where a fictionalized version of myself travels across this world documenting its peoples cultures politics and history 125 years after a catastrophic nuclear war heres a brief rundown of the different geographies shown here uniguitaunited federation of commonwealths west a large liberal democracy uniguita is unarguably the most powerful and wealthiest nation in the postwar world formed from the ashes of the prewar hegelioferrian empire the federation stretches from its capital of nova espero city in the southwest all the way to lankolay in the northeast heres a basic regional rundown of the country hegelion nec ne eh nh and md hegelion located in the far southwestern reaches of the continent on the hegelion peninsula is the ancestral homeland of the hegelion people at the very end of the peninsula is the city of nova espero the capital of the federation born out of the rubble of the prewar imperial capital of hegeliopolis nova espero is a cosmopolitan city home to government institutions cultural centers and a diverse array of people hegelion more broadly is known for its staid middleclass culture though its industrial sector has taken a hit in recent decades impoverishing some of the regions more manufacturingheavy counties north hegelion is home to port williams a vast marine city known for its significant ylrikian and crescent islander diaspora communities the northwest sw zh po and vo a geographically and demographically diverse region the northwest is a hodgepodge of different cultures and peoples swalabash is home to the namesake people known for their marine culture and for swamping the art of eel hunting the commonwealths vast kilmartin swamps zoldhegyek is a mountainous region that is proud of its history and fastidious adherence to the old hegelionic church pravo is another mountainous region and ethnic homeland to the prav population vetludo is a commonwealth known for its timbering wine and vast gambling opportunities in its eponymous capital city terre de lac ct pn and tn home to the proud and hardy lacaise people terre de lac is known for its timber industry maple syrup fishing opportunities frigid winters and the romantic beauty of the northern outpost city of pierron though it faced threats from new hegelion during the civil war tdl is now a popular tourist destination known for its cool summers and bountiful wintertime activities the east se dt pk and ly categorizable primarily on the basis of geography the east is home to a diverse array of peoples lankolay ly is home to the kolfarist people an ethnoreligious group centered around devotion to their leader kolfar kolfar kolfar 3k as hes affectionately known and president erika lankolay 48 pm 60 pm who is credited with liberating the region from neighboring pabomkak pk when it was an independent kingdom pabomkak is a largely desertified commonwealth centered on its western lake now known for its strong technologyoriented economy the desert territories dt are largely uninhabited desert that in combination with pabomkak form the arid center region of the continent south erachnia se is a mountainous commonwealth that is ethnically close with the republic of erachnia more on them later sherbrooke sb and sd once a battleground between ylrikia and the hegelioferrian empire and where the war that ended the premilito world began sherbrooke is a region that is an ethnic and cultural blend between the hegelioferrian west and the ylrikian east uniguita ultimately won the region during the uniguitanylrikian war of the 40s and it has been one of the most populous and economically productive regions of the country ever since ferria ef fa and sf the other principal people group of the hegelioferrian empire the ferrians are known for their warmness and generosity and their modern zeal for democracy the cities and fishing villages hugging the bahia ferraa are known for their sumptuous feasts of ferrian crabs and hearty vegetables puerto ostra is known for its annual cockroach day celebration a festival honoring the locals survival following the war the ferrian backcountry particularly the region of concordia is known for its highgrade wine production the fertile center ko ps lo and kn these vast agricultural states make up the fertile center a region known for its sweeping river valleys and abundant fecund land after a brief climatic change as a result of the war the region returned to being a breadbasket for the federation challenged in its productivity only by the ylrik river valley wollstone island wi a large island located far off the southern coast of ferria wollstone island is primarily known for its temperate climate large sheepherding and wool industry and easygoing lifestyle it is a popular destination for nomads and mainland burnouts alike who appreciate the islands reduced speed the ylrikian empire far east massive continental power and successor state to the prewar ylrikian empire though the throne has changed hands the postwar empire is steeped in prewar traditions culture and customs the empires massive mainland population is supported by the massive fertile river valley that forms its central spine while the coastal lowlands are pocked with dozens of industrial hubs once an autocracy like its prewar predecessor the modern ylrikian empire has been a constitutional multiparty parliamentary democracy with a monarchy since the revolution of 100 pm though the democracy has stabilized it faces pressures for independence from its colonial possessions such as the crescent islands and the central mountains as well as revisionist pressures from the increasingly popular farright loyalty and prosperity party which ruled the country from 77 pm to 100 pm the republic of erachnianorth erachnia far northeast continental middle power with a population largely concentrated in the subarctic mountainous southeast around its capital and largest city of erachnistaat a hardscrabble people the erachnians fought off invasions from the ylrikians and the new hegelions more on them later during the 90s in a catastrophic war that dealt significant damage to their infrastructure and killed tens of thousands today the country is facing influence from uniguita to the southwest ylrikia to the southeast and new hegelion to the west its economy and living standards are behind those of the continental powers though they do have a significant resource extraction industry new hegelion far northwest a breakaway region from uniguita new hegelions government is dominated by the farright hegelion supremacist security and justice party an ethnic people originating in the southwestern reaches of the continent the hegelions were among the two principal power groups in the prewar hegelioferrian empire through the tides of postwar uniguitan history hegelion supremacists began to colonize the far north as a means of creating an unspoiled homeland for the hegelion people as the region grew more powerful politically its contraventions of the egalitarian uniguitan constitution became harder to ignore leading to increased conflict with the federal government in the 70s and 80s in the early 90s the region broke away leading to the uniguitan civil war a series of strategic blunders and a growing fatigue with the war in southern uniguita led to an eventual armistice but a formal treaty recognizing new hegelions independence was never signed though ylrikia sponsored the breakaway region for the first few years of its existence the collapse of that countrys autocracy led to its abandonment geopolitically because the uniguitans themselves lack the appetite to retake the region in a rehash of the civil war and it is now an international pariah state new hegelion remains an impoverished racist authoritarian regime stuck in a frigid limbo madawba sandwiched between ylrikia and uniguita the only state on the continent to survive the war largely intact madawba is an insular democracy though it has only had one party in power for the past 125 years in the high mountains between ylrikia and uniguita surviving off of rations stocked in massive vaults prior to the war madawba became a highly efficient and militarized state in its aftermath during the uniguitanylrikian cold war from the late 40s until the dawn of the second century madawba often played host to international conferences and treaty negotiations today the nation is home to many international organizations such as the kagzmeraki union and the international health association if this world seems like something youd be interested in learning more about please subscribe to my substack dispatches from uniguita new articles will be uploaded every tuesday at 1200 eastern

are those two storylines too disjointed for the book trilogy im writing hi there ive been working on this scifiscience fantasy book trilogy its centered on two storylines and to explain my question i have to explain the lore a bit the story takes place in an universe in which humanity first took to the stars after being on the brink of extinction due to continuous wars and climate change what saves them was a deal with godlike cosmic entities called the dreams and fears that is they are called the dreams and fears by humans because they present themselves as the embodiment of humans dreams and fears giving humanity the means of survival in the form of magic in exchange of regular human sacrifices as such over time about 300 years humanity conquered the galaxy and formed an empire worshiping the dreams and fears and sacrificing their own to them culturally speaking human sacrifices are seen as a good and honorable thing in the empire as it is considered a celebration and the church frames being chosen to be sacrificed as an honor but unbeknownst to the wider world the dreams and fears treat the souls of those sacrificed as their food and store them into a place they call the kenosis to slowly digest them the souls are stripped of their memories of the world upon their arrival and the rest of their personality is slowly eaten away turning them into mindless husks now onto the storylines proper they are separate for the first two books but converge on the third book one storyline takes place in the kenosis and follows a soul trying to escape the other takes place in the empire or the material world as i call it as a distinction to the kenosis and follows a civil war from the pov of the emperors third son and of a young talented soldier heres the kicker the soul trying to escape the kenosis is also a character from the empire storyline shes a friend of both pov characters and is sacrificed by her father who is a wellrespected general at the end of book 1 at the end of book 2 the girl manages to escape the kenosis but she wakes up entirely devoid of her memories of the material world my problem is this despite the clear link between the two narratives im still a bit worried those two storylines are too disjointed to belong in the same books after all the genres they belong to are somewhat different the kenosis storyline is more cosmic horror and the empire storyline is more space operagrandiose scifi and they dont converge immediately is it better for these two stories to be in different fully separate books im just quite torn i cant really see those two stories being separate or at least be strong enough on their own to be separate because im really keen on that twist i planned in book 2 with this character being revealed to connect those two stories together however part of me is scared i cant pull this kind of thing off any advice im also curious to hear if that pitch is interesting and not too messy
